title: Keep Enough Payments During Node Drains
description:
**SITUATION:**

Cluster upgrades drain nodes. Without a safety net, Kubernetes can evict almost every Payment Handler Pod at once — payments drop during maintenance. A **Pod Disruption Budget** tells the cluster: “never voluntarily evict so many that we go below N available.”

This lab adds a **PodDisruptionBudget** so node drains cannot evict all Payment Handler Pods at once. It limits voluntary disruption during maintenance — it does not replace probes or anti-affinity.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create a **PodDisruptionBudget** for Payment Handler.
2. Verify it selects the payment Pods and enforces the availability floor (optional: observe a drain that respects the PDB).

**SPEC:**

- PDB name: `payment-handler-pdb`
- Selector: `app=payment-handler`
- `minAvailable`: **3**  (out of 5 replicas — at most 2 can be down from voluntary disruption)
- Success: PDB exists; `ALLOWED disruptions` / status reflects the budget

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest: `payment-handler-pdb-l39.yaml`.
- Use `minAvailable` (not `maxUnavailable`) for this lab.
- PDB only limits **voluntary** disruptions (drains, evictions) — not node crashes.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.
Work only in your lab namespace (not default).
Read SPEC carefully, apply your YAML, then Submit.

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Keep Enough Payments During Node Drains

Stay in your lab namespace. Create a PodDisruptionBudget so voluntary drains cannot take Payment Handler below 3 available Pods.

Docs: [Pod Disruption Budgets](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/)

## Solution YAML

Save as `payment-handler-pdb-l39.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: payment-handler-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-handler
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f payment-handler-pdb-l39.yaml
kubectl get pdb payment-handler-pdb
kubectl describe pdb payment-handler-pdb
```

Confirm `MIN AVAILABLE` is **3** and the selector matches payment Pods, then **Submit**. Use `minAvailable` (not `maxUnavailable`).
